meta.coverage: 633 explicit capability mappings, 10 verified native keyword/class mappings, and three registered items whose combat style is unverified. Knaves’ Needs includes only the confirmed Twilight Forest weapons. This is a dated static catalogue, not a live server registry dump.
meta.statsSemantics: Capability attributes are additive bonuses, not final damage or DPS. Style-specific fields override common fields; common fills missing fields. Missing values inherit from the native preset and are not zero.
meta.baseStatsSemantics: Base item figures are native main-hand attribute totals before Epic Fight bonuses, skills, abilities, enchantments and progression. Verified for 133 Simply Swords and five Thaumaturge Tinker weapons.
meta.knavesNeedsScope: Twilight Forest weapons only, confirmed by the pack owner on 2026-11-18.
